01

“Certainly will the believers have succeeded”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 23:1).

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Shayban related to us, from Jabir, from Mujahid, who said:
"God, Mighty and Majestic, planted the Gardens of Eden with His own hand, and when they were complete He closed them. They are opened every dawn, and God, Mighty and Majestic, looks at them and says: Certainly will the believers have succeeded [al-Muminun 1]."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:
" إِنَّ اللَّهَ عز وجل غَرَسَ جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ بِيَدِهِ، فَلَمَّا تَكَامَلَتْ أُغْلِقَتْ فَهِيَ تُفْتَحُ فِي كُلِّ سَحَرٍ فَيَنْظُرُ اللَّهُ عز وجل إِلَيْهَا فَيَقُولُ: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ [المؤمنون: 1] "
Edition record 372820 · p. 484Link to report ↗
02

“then We developed him into another creation”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 23:14).

02
Explanation from Mujāhid 02

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
then We developed him into another creation [al-Muminun 14] meaning: "he reached the prime of youth."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
ثُمَّ أَنْشَأَنْاهُ خَلْقًا آخَرَ [المؤمنون: 14] ، يَعْنِي: «اسْتَوَى شَبَابًا»
Edition record 372821 · p. 484Link to report ↗

Explanation from Mujāhid 07

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

Transmission wording

Explanation from Mujāhid 11

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

Transmission wording

10

“Do they think that what We extend to them of wealth”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 23:55, 23:56).

13
Explanation from Mujāhid 13

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
Do they think that what We extend to them of wealth [al-Muminun 55] that is: "of wealth We give them," and children is [because] We hasten for them good things? But they do not perceive [al-Muminun 56]. He says: do they think that what We give them of wealth and children is because We intend good for them? Rather, We grant them respite, but they do not perceive. This is for Quraysh.
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
أَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُمْ بِهِ مِنْ مَالٍ [المؤمنون: 55] أَيْ: «نُعْطِيهِمْ مِنْ مَالٍ» وَبَنِينَ نُسَارِعُ لَهُمْ فِي الْخَيْرَاتِ بَلْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ [المؤمنون: 56] يَقُولُ: أَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّ مَا نُعْطِيهِمْ مِنْ مَالٍ وَبَنِينَ وَنُرِيدُ بِهِمُ الْخَيْرَ، أَيْ بَلْ نُمْلِي لَهُمْ وَلَكِنْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ، هَذَا لِقُرَيْشٍ "
Edition record 372832 · p. 486Link to report ↗
11

“and their hearts are fearful”

An explanation transmitted from al-Awwam ibn Hawshab (Q 23:60).

14
Explanation from al-Awwam ibn Hawshab 14

al-Awwam ibn Hawshab

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Hushaym related to us, from al-Awwam ibn Hawshab, who said:
Abu Jafar al-Ashjai related to us, from Aisha, Mother of the Believers, on the words of God, Mighty and Majestic: and their hearts are fearful [al-Muminun 60]. She said: "They are those who fear God and obey Him."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنِ الْعَوَّامِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ، قَالَ: ثنا أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ الْأَشْجَعِيُّ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، فِي قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عز وجل:
وَقُلُوبُهُمْ وَجِلَةٌ [المؤمنون: 60] قَالَتْ: «هُمُ الَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ اللَّهَ وَيُطِيعُونَهُ»
Edition record 372833 · p. 486Link to report ↗

17

“and behind them is a barrier until the Day they are resurrected”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 23:100).

21
Explanation from Mujāhid 21

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
and behind them is a barrier until the Day they are resurrected [al-Muminun 100] he said: "The barzakh is the partition between death and the return to the world." Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: al-Mubarak ibn Fudala related to us, from al-Hasan, who said: "The barzakh is these graves that lie between you and the Hereafter."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَمِنْ وَرَائِهِمْ بَرْزَخٌ إِلَى يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ [المؤمنون: 100] قَالَ: " الْبَرْزَخُ: الْحَاجِزُ بَيْنَ الْمَوْتِ وَالرُّجُوعِ إِلَى الدُّنْيَا ". أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا الْمُبَارَكُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ: " الْبَرْزَخُ: هِيَ هَذِهِ الْقُبُورُ الَّتِي بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَ الْآخِرَةِ "
